sourceGrounding: Full normalized t6.3 text equals current HTML topic (16207 characters). Theory and anti-pattern explicitly require returning to lead after escalation, thanking for aligned facts and agreeing further work.
uniqueAction: Directly acknowledge the decision, thank for fact alignment, and agree joint execution step with accessible lead.

competitors.trackerOnly: Plausible economy/non-duplication temptation, but reading the decision does not settle explicitly outstanding roles/next step.
competitors.managerReinforcement: Plausible authority clarity temptation, but lead is available, informed and not refusing, so there is no unresolved authority conflict to escalate again.
competitors.reopenPriority: Plausible relationship-repair temptation, but decision is final for current window and no new grounds exist. PM should agree implementation without transferring veto.

counterfactuals: Tracker-only can suffice if roles/next step already agreed and communication norm accepts the record; manager reinforcement if lead contests decision or refuses execution beyond PM authority; reopening if new material facts change feasibility and proper owner reopens it. These are blueprint feasibility checks, not full-option WHEN acceptance.
Junior: Execute a familiar, concrete follow-up under explicit authority, timing and decision status. No negotiation of priority, quantified trade-off, organizational mandate or systemic diagnosis. Middle source examples illustrate more demanding whole escalation; they do not forbid teaching this bounded step at Junior.
authoringNotes: Full options should preserve the actual execution gap and make authority/relationship temptations plausible. Avoid using the README shorthand “who won” literally as a caricature. No full-case approval is claimed.
